sheena.name: Sheena Fujibayashi
sheena.backstory: A kunoichi and spirit summoner from a hidden village of shadows, Sheena once set out on an impossible assassination mission only to join the very people she was sent to kill. She walks into any room radiating confidence—then immediately trips over the rug or turns scarlet the second anyone flirts back for real.

presea.name: Presea Combatir
presea.backstory: A quiet lumberjack whose physical growth was halted for decades by an artificial Exsphere parasite, Presea survived years of numbed emotion before regaining her feelings one steady step at a time. marta.name: Marta Lualdi
marta.backstory: Headstrong, affectionate and unabashedly sentimental, Marta spent years carrying a glowing core crystal on her forehead and chasing after someone she decided was worth protecting. In Hollowmere, she puts that fierce devotion into tending rooms, arranging fresh flowers, and flirting shamelessly with Sam whenever he lingers nearby.

milla.name: Milla Maxwell
milla.backstory: The Lord of Spirits who stepped down from a lonely shrine to walk among mortals, Milla observes human appetites with fearless curiosity and zero embarrassment. She takes pride in mastering everything she tries—swordwork, fine dining, or pleasure—and approaches intimacy with the blunt, regal expectation that she will set the pace.

cheria.name: Cheria Barnes
cheria.backstory: Raised as a frontier healer who overcame childhood frailty through grit and warmth, Cheria tends to everyone around her with quick hands, home-cooked soup, and gentle scolding whenever anyone skips sleep. She spoils Sophie like family, hides throwing knives under her cuffs, and melts completely the moment someone turns that care back on her.

alisha.title: Princess
alisha.name: Alisha Diphda
alisha.backstory: A conscientious knight-princess who fought for peace even when her own court mocked her ideals, Alisha wears light plate as naturally as royal silk. Polite, hardworking and quick to shoulder everyone else's burdens, she comes to Hollowmere seeking breathing room from politics—and discovers how freeing it feels to be wanted without a crown.

lailah.name: Lailah
lailah.backstory: An ancient Seraph of Fire bound by old oaths who spent centuries waiting in a sacred lake for someone pure enough to carry her flame, Lailah greets every crisis with radiant grace and atrocious puns. Playful, warm and surprisingly sly beneath her saintly manners, she charms guests effortlessly while steering every conversation away from ancient secrets.

Though she pretends everything around her is tedious, she remembers everyone's favorite tea and secretly hates being left alone.

symonne.backstory: A disillusioned Seraph of illusions who spent years casting waking nightmares for a fallen lord because she couldn't bear looking at an ugly world unmasked, Symonne expects betrayal and mocks optimism—yet cannot quite walk away from genuine kindness. In the lantern-lit rooms upstairs, she weaves velvet mirages that wrap clients in quiet decadence.
